description.value: The Mission Branch is part of the Okanagan Regional Library (ORL), a regional system of 30 branches serving over 399,000 people across the Okanagan and surrounding areas, established in 1936. Located in the Mission neighbourhood of Kelowna on Gordon Drive, it offers typical public library services including books, digital resources, and programs. As a free public institution, it can be a useful rest and resource stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific Mission branch page (https://www.orl.bc.ca/hours-locations/mission) returns a 404 'Page not found' error, so no branch-specific amenity details are available from the website. However, the ORL website's branch selector dropdown and contact page both list 'Kelowna - Mission' as an active branch, confirming the branch exists within the ORL system. OSM tags provide the address, phone, and internet_access=wlan, but per rules OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website confirmation, and the branch page is unavailable.
concerns: The OSM website URL (https://www.orl.bc.ca/hours-locations/mission) returns a 404 'Page not found' error; the branch-specific page may have moved or been reorganised. The correct URL for the Mission branch may differ.
No branch-specific amenity or contact details could be confirmed from the website due to the 404 error. All amenity fields remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The branch is confirmed to exist as an active ORL location (listed in the system's branch selector and contact page). It is a real, publicly accessible library useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tag internet_access=wlan suggests Wi-Fi is available, but this could not be confirmed via the website due to the broken branch URL. The ORL system broadly offers digital resources and online access across its branches.
